errors.evidence: The figure shows 'Kultur' as 2.2% in 2014 (inner ring) and 2.4% in 2021 (outer ring), but the description reverses these values.
The figure shows 'Sport/Erholung' as 2.4% in 2014 (inner ring) and 3.6% in 2021 (outer ring), but the description incorrectly states 4.1% for 2014.
The figure shows 'Wohnungswesen' as 4.1% in 2014 (inner ring) and 7.2% in 2021 (outer ring), but the description incorrectly states 8.4% for 2014.
The figure uses black for 'Gasversorgung,' but the description incorrectly assigns it as 'Dunkelgrau' (dark gray).
The figure uses dark blue for 'Wasserversorgung,' but the description incorrectly assigns it as 'Mittelblau' (medium blue).
The description does not explicitly state that the chart compares relative percentages of different categories between 2014 and 2021.
The description does not mention that the inner ring represents 2014 and the outer ring represents 2021, which is a key structural feature of the chart.
The description omits the observation that the largest segment, 'Übrige,' increased from 31.1% in 2014 to 38.1% in 2021.
The description does not mention that the values are expressed in percentages, which is indicated in the chart title.
